title: Explaining comparisons and causes
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply explaining comparisons and causes in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 比较两种出行方式，并解释偏好变化的原因。
grammar: 比较围绕同一维度，如 reliability/cost/flexibility。whereas 对照，because 解释原因，as a result 引出后果；不要把相关经历自动推广为人人如此。
common_mistake: ‘公交更便宜，自行车是绿色的’若无共同标准，比较可能零散。

examples.text: For my current commute, cycling is more predictable than taking the bus.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: The road has a protected cycle lane, whereas the bus often waits in traffic near the station.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: However, the bus is more convenient when I carry heavy equipment.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: My preference changed after I moved closer to work, because the shorter distance made cycling practical.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: For my current commute, cycling is more predictable than taking the bus. The road has a protected cycle lane, whereas the bus often waits in traffic near the station. However, the bus is more convenient when I carry heavy equipment. My preference changed after I moved closer to work, because the shorter distance made cycling practical. Someone living much farther away might reach a different conclusion. The useful comparison is therefore between the options for a particular journey, not between cyclists and bus passengers as groups.

questions.answer: The speaker moved closer to work.
questions.explanation: 个人情境变化是原因，不是所有公交变差。

questions.prompt: Give a shared comparison dimension in the response.
questions.explanation: 同一旅程的可靠性使比较具有共同基准。
